{{Quote|A hyperspace sinkhole is all that remains of the Waymancy bridal seat, and on a thousand Rim worlds the flag of the Republic flies high.|Supreme Chancellor Nagratha|<ref name="Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-part-4-the-rise-of-the-republic-needs-author-entry|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 4: The Rise of the Republic}}</ref>}}
A '''hyperspace sinkhole''' was a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] phenomenon. By the conclusion of the [[Waymancy Storm]] conflict, the object known as the [[Waymancy bridal seat]] had been reduced to a hyperspace sinkhole.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
